title: GGCMI Phase 3 crop calendars
description: Planting and maturity dates per crop, used to build the jagermeyr crop-calendar timeframe.
gaps: Setup gates the download on a bare file count of 40, not on a manifest.

No checksum manifest (#58): the PIK index page timed out from the macbook on 2026-11-02, so the links could not be listed. Build it from a host that reaches the index: Rscript R/checks/75_catalogue_manifest.R --build --dataset ggcmi-crop-calendars.

changelog.change: Acquisition recipe registered; this is now the only supported way to fetch it.
Added checksum manifest: 40 object(s), 3,153,182 bytes, verify=size. Listed from the origin by R/checks/75_catalogue_manifest.R (headers only); R/00_acquire.R checks every download against it.
